description: Lock the quote and get a single-use signing link for the customer (the customer signs on the hosted page; an agent cannot sign or accept a quote). Who may send is shops.sendPermissions: the owner always may, office for any job, a lead for jobs on their crew, and a field worker for jobs assigned to them, until the owner turns that off. Lines an agent drafted are refused until a person who may send quotes sends the quote. An agent token cannot send those lines.

email_customer.description: Also email the customer a branded email with their own signing link, from the shop. Default false: you share sign_url yourself.

name: quotes_send
